title: Mobile Phone Lost – What To Do? (Complete Step-by-Step Guide)
intro: Aaj ke digital time me mobile phone sirf calling device nahi balki bank, documents, photos aur personal data ka store hota hai. Agar aapka mobile phone kho jata hai ya chori ho jata hai, to panic karna natural hai. Lekin agar sahi steps sahi time par follow kiye jayein, to aap apna data secure rakh sakte hain aur financial loss se bach sakte hain. Is article me hum aapko mobile phone lost hone par kya karein, kaise track karein, SIM kaise block karein aur police complaint kaise file karein – sab kuch detail me batayenge.

sections.heading: Step 1: Sabse Pehle Kya Karein (Immediate Actions)
content: Sabse pehle apna SIM card turant block karwa dein. Iske liye apne telecom operator (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL) ke customer care number par call karein.
SIM block karne se koi bhi OTP, call ya message misuse nahi ho payega.
Agar mobile me banking apps hain (UPI, Net Banking), to bank ko bhi inform karein.

sections.heading: Step 2: Mobile Phone Track Kaise Karein
content: Agar aap Android phone use karte hain, to Google Find My Device ka use karein.
iPhone users Apple Find My iPhone ka use kar sakte hain.
Isse aap last known location dekh sakte hain, phone ring kar sakte hain ya data erase kar sakte hain.
Phone band hone par bhi last location visible ho sakti hai.

sections.heading: Step 3: Google, WhatsApp & Accounts Secure Karein
content: Google account ka password turant change karein.
WhatsApp ke liye new SIM lene ke baad same number se login karein.
Email, social media aur payment apps ke passwords bhi update karein.

sections.heading: Step 4: Police Complaint & CEIR Portal
content: Agar phone recover nahi hota, to nearest police station me FIR ya lost report file karein.
Government ke CEIR portal par IMEI number ke through phone block karwa sakte hain.
IMEI number aapko phone box, bill ya Google account me mil jata hai.

sections.heading: Step 5: Agar Phone Mil Jaye To Kya Karein
content: SIM unblock karwa sakte hain.
Accounts ko verify karein aur suspicious activity check karein.
CEIR me phone unblock request dal sakte hain.

faq.q: Agar phone switch off ho to kya track ho sakta hai?
faq.a: Haan, Google Find My Device ya Apple Find My iPhone par last known location dikh sakti hai.
Haan, insurance claim aur CEIR blocking ke liye FIR ya lost report useful hoti hai.
Phone ke bill, box ya Google account ke Device section me IMEI mil jata hai.

conclusion: Mobile phone lost hona stressful hota hai, lekin agar aap upar bataye gaye steps follow karte hain to aap apne data aur paise dono ko secure rakh sakte hain. Hamesha calm rahein, official tools ka use karein aur kisi bhi unknown link ya call par trust na karein.

title: UPI Transaction Failed – Refund Process
intro: UPI transaction fail hone par paisa wapas mil jata hai, bas sahi process follow karna hota hai.
steps: UPI app me transaction status check karein
Kam se kam 24–48 ghante wait karein (auto refund aata hai)
UPI app ke help/support section se complaint raise karein
Agar refund na aaye to bank customer care se contact karein

faq.q: UPI refund kitne din me aata hai?
faq.a: Aksar 3–5 working days ke andar refund credit ho jata hai.

title: Best Free AI Tools for Students (2026)
intro: Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools students ke liye study, assignments, resume aur productivity ke liye kaafi helpful hote hain.

sections.heading: Why Students Should Use AI Tools?
content: AI tools time save karte hain aur productivity badhate hain
Assignments aur notes fast aur accurate bante hain
Resume, presentations aur projects professional dikhte hain

sections.heading: Top Free AI Tools for Students

Canva AI – presentations, posters aur designs ke liye
Grammarly – English writing aur grammar improve karne ke liye
Notion AI – notes, planning aur task management ke liye

sections.heading: How AI Helps in Exams & Study
content: Quick revision notes generate karna
Difficult topics ko easy language me samajhna
Practice questions aur mock ideas banana

conclusion: AI tools students ke liye ek smart study assistant ki tarah kaam karte hain. Agar inka sahi aur limited use kiya jaye, to ye exams aur career dono me kaafi madadgar sabit ho sakte hain.
